invariants_verified: AtlasLocalMissionCoordinator composes the existing zero-credential AtlasLocalRuntime with the durable MissionStore rather than introducing a second local policy or execution authority.
A booking-change input creates one deterministic Mission bound to the local project hash, then persists CREATED, READY, ACTIVE and WAITING_APPROVAL lifecycle events before any committed effect.
The local fixture proposal crosses the policy and approval boundary; no Action is present before operator approval.
Approval persists a durable approval wait and transitions the Mission through ACTIVE to WAITING_EVENT while the committed Action, outcome, outbox and runtime receipts remain inspectable.
Delivery resumes WAITING_EVENT through ACTIVE and COMPLETING to COMPLETED, with delivery receipts and the local runtime outbox state inspectable.
Reopening the coordinator reloads both Mission persistence and local runtime persistence at inbound, approval and delivery checkpoints.
Identical input replays without creating a second Mission or Action; changed content under the same message ID raises IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH.
The deterministic journey requires no Atlas account, provider credential, cloud service or paid model key.

verification.command: cd packages/atlas && npm run metadata:write && npm test && npm run build && git diff --check

limitations: The executable coordinator is a zero-credential local implementation over filesystem-backed runtime and Mission persistence.

MissionStore governed Decision, Action and Receipt collections remain available for later contract-level integration; this coordinator exposes the existing local runtime's governed fixture records and receipts without fabricating provider receipts.
CI, staging, provider sandbox, limited production, production Cloud persistence, real provider delivery, billing settlement and commercial operation remain unclaimed.
P1-006 Mission control surfaces and P1-007 independent build-readiness review remain later work.
verdict: ATLAS-BMR2-P1-005 = PASS — one complete deterministic local Mission journey is locally proven with durable lifecycle state, approval gating, committed effect, inspectable receipts, restart recovery and replay safety; no stronger environment maturity is claimed.
